pure-canvas.$description: Pure Canvas — Page background, card surface, image mask — the baseline white everything else sits on

bone.$description: Bone — Alternate section background, subtle warm-off-white band between content blocks

mist.$description: Mist — Nav and section fills that need a barely-there elevation above canvas

silk-border.$description: Silk Border — Hairline card and divider borders — defines surfaces without painting them

quill.$description: Quill — Link and secondary border treatment, lighter dividers inside dense blocks

ash.$description: Ash — Muted helper text, disabled labels, low-emphasis icon strokes

pebble.$description: Pebble — Body text and default neutral borders — the workhorse mid-gray

slate.$description: Slate — Secondary text, button borders in outlined controls, sub-label icons

graphite.$description: Graphite — Nav text, stronger body text for emphasis without going to black

iron.$description: Iron — Link text in dark contexts, strong card borders on featured surfaces

charcoal.$description: Charcoal — Primary text and dark button fills — the near-black that keeps contrast warm

midnight.$description: Midnight — Display text, deepest heading weight, high-contrast inverse text

signal-blue.$description: Signal Blue — Violet action color for filled buttons, selected navigation states, and focused conversion moments.

ember-stroke.$description: Ember Stroke — Decorative borders, badge outlines, icon accents — warm orange that warms the cool white canvas without competing with Signal Blue

alarm-red.$description: Alarm Red — Red outline accent for tags, dividers, and focused UI edges. Use as a supporting accent, not as a status color

tiempos-headline.$description: All display and heading copy — headlines, hero statements, section titles, large numbers. The single weight 300 is a deliberate anti-convention: instead of bold, Tiempos whispers, and the editorial serif does the work of authority through restraint rather than volume.

selecta.$description: All UI, body, navigation, button, badge, and caption text. Weight 400 is the body default, 500 for emphasized UI labels and nav items. The slightly open tracking (+0.025em) on small sizes gives the interface an airy, legible quality that pairs against the dense serif headlines.
